title: T-minus
hints: The loop position must live in the `CountdownIterator`, not in `Countdown`. `Countdown` only remembers `start`, and its `__iter__` builds a new iterator each time.
`CountdownIterator.__init__` sets `self.remaining = start`. `__next__` raises `StopIteration` when `remaining` is 0, and otherwise hands out the current value and decrements.

def __next__(self) -> int:
    if self.remaining <= 0: raise StopIteration
    value = self.remaining
    self.remaining -= 1
    return value
